description: Bash permissions the lt CLI copies verbatim into the user settings for auto-approval. A rule narrowed or dropped here moves to formerPatterns, from which the CLI removes it once from existing settings. A trailing ':*' equals a trailing ' *' and is recognised only at the end of a pattern; a colon anywhere else, escaped or not, is a literal character. Every rule applies in every project, so a pattern names the narrow command its description states; broad tools (curl, node, docker run, git push) are granted per turn through a command's allowed-tools instead. Plugin helper scripts are not listed: settings do not expand ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}, and a '*' in a script path also matches '../', so a wildcard script rule approves any code; commands grant each script by exact name per turn.
